# Previews

A plain wikilink to [[Luhmann]], and one into a section: [[Sections#How it works]].

A heading that does not exist: [[Sections#Nowhere]]. One that only exists inside
a code fence: [[Sections#Hidden]]. A section with nothing under it:
[[Sections#Nothing under here]]. A block reference: [[Sections#^abc123]].

A markdown link written by hand: [the sections note](/sections).

A dead one: [[Nothing At All]]. Nothing on [an external one](https://example.com)
or a [protocol-relative one](//example.com/notes/luhmann).
